responsibility: Implements the MMIX target backend logic behind the macros and RTL patterns for this port. It supplies target hook bodies and helper routines for ABI and option handling, argument passing and return conventions, frame layout and prologue/epilogue generation, EH and nonlocal-goto support, address legality and reload decisions, condition-code mode selection and branch-condition printing, constant decomposition, register naming/renumbering, section and symbol encoding, and final MMIX assembly emission for data, labels, thunks, and other target-specific constructs.
same_name_distinction: Backend implementation file for the MMIX port: it provides the C++ hook bodies and helper routines referenced by the target macros in mmix.h and by the RTL patterns/expanders in mmix.md, rather than declaring target properties, defining instruction patterns, or listing command-line options like the other same-stem files.
